title: RETRACTION: 0.910 was memorisation — 2,313 holdout copies were inside the training set
symptom: A finetune reached 0.836 on the supposedly unseen holdout at epoch 1, and a stem audit found all 1,977 cwd12 holdout images present in the merged train directory under two unbanned slug names.
root_cause: Slug-level NEVER_TRAIN could not see that cottonweed_sp8 (1,229) and cottonweed_holdout (748) physically contained the holdout images; v3.0.25 oversampling duplicated some of them up to 10x.
correction_made: Stem-level holdout filter at merge (drops any image whose stem is in the holdout set, whatever the slug), with a skipped_holdout_stem counter; all v3.0.24-v3.0.27 holdout numbers retracted.
